extract.note: Left out by path. subset=Web/source=Youtube Commons: YouTube offers only the CC BY 3.0 license, while its rows read ["https://spdx.org/licenses/CC-BY-4.0", "https://spdx.org/licenses/CC-BY-4.0"] or ["https://spdx.org/licenses/CC-BY-4.0"], a contradiction; and its transcripts include YouTube's automatic translations: the YouTube-Commons card (https://huggingface.co/datasets/PleIAs/YouTube-Commons) says "The collection comprises 22,709,724 original and automatically translated transcripts". subset=Cultural/source=MOSEL: machine transcripts by a speech model; the MOSEL card (https://huggingface.co/datasets/FBK-MT/mosel) says "The data is transcribed using Whisper large v3". ShareAlike (every row of each reads ["https://spdx.org/licenses/CC-BY-SA-4.0"]): subset=Cultural/source=DiBiLit, subset=Cultural/source=DiBiPhil, subset=Cultural/source=Wikiquote, subset=Cultural/source=Wikisource, subset=Cultural/source=Wikivoyage, subset=Political/source=Reichtagsprotokolle, subset=Scientific/source=Directory of Open Access Books, subset=Scientific/source=Polytechnisches Journal, subset=Scientific/source=Wikibooks, subset=Scientific/source=Wikiversity, subset=Web/source=Wiki Discussions, subset=Web/source=Wikipedia. README.md and DATASHEET.md: the card and datasheet, under ODC-BY-1.0 by the card's own statement, a license still waiting for the linking test. bloom_filter.bin: a binary Bloom filter, not text. Kept but entering nothing: subset=News/source=Wikinews, whose card row says CC-BY-4.0 while every row reads ["https://spdx.org/licenses/CC-BY-SA-4.0"], a value no entry lists.

Collections whose records carry this license, as the card names and links them: The Stack (Markdown and TXT Subsets) (https://huggingface.co/datasets/bigcode/the-stack-dedup). Each record's source field names its collection and its id field its identifier there; both are listed in the model's CREDITS file for this source. The texts were changed by German Commons; its datasheet says: "Paragraph-level deduplication may alter texts from their original form. Personally identifiable information has been systematically removed."
licenses.text:
Records whose license field reads exactly ["https://spdx.org/licenses/CC-BY-4.0", "https://spdx.org/licenses/Apache-2.0"] (the field is a list; WPT reads it as that JSON text).

The dataset card says of the license field: "List of applicable licenses for each document, given as canonical SPDX license URL." and "This dataset aggregation and metadata is released under ODC-BY license. Individual documents have their own specific licenses - please check the `license` field for each record." The datasheet says: "Metadata (licensing, thematic classification, source attribution) was extracted directly from source repository information or explicitly provided by institutional datasets."

The record's list names several licenses, which apply at once: their AND (docs/licenses.md, "Per record" and "Several licenses on one file"), so this entry holds every one of their texts.

The publisher labels each of these records with this license, and that label is the record's proof (docs/licenses.md, "The publication decides" and "Per record", maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23).

The dataset card says of the license field: "List of applicable licenses for each document, given as canonical SPDX license URL." and "This dataset aggregation and metadata is released under ODC-BY license. Individual documents have their own specific licenses - please check the `license` field for each record." The datasheet says: "Metadata (licensing, thematic classification, source attribution) was extracted directly from source repository information or explicitly provided by institutional datasets."

The record's list names several licenses, which apply at once: their AND (docs/licenses.md, "Per record" and "Several licenses on one file"), so this entry holds every one of their texts.

The publisher labels each of these records with this license, and that label is the record's proof (docs/licenses.md, "The publication decides" and "Per record", maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23).

Collections whose records carry this license, as the card names and links them: The Stack (Markdown and TXT Subsets) (https://huggingface.co/datasets/bigcode/the-stack-dedup). Each record's source field names its collection and its id field its identifier there; both are listed in the model's CREDITS file for this source. The texts were changed by German Commons; its datasheet says: "Paragraph-level deduplication may alter texts from their original form. Personally identifiable information has been systematically removed."
licenses.text:
Records whose license field reads exactly ["https://spdx.org/licenses/CC-BY-4.0", "https://spdx.org/licenses/Unlicense"] or ["https://spdx.org/licenses/CC-BY-4.0", "https://spdx.org/licenses/CC-BY-4.0", "https://spdx.org/licenses/Unlicense"] (the field is a list; WPT reads it as that JSON text).

The dataset card says of the license field: "List of applicable licenses for each document, given as canonical SPDX license URL." and "This dataset aggregation and metadata is released under ODC-BY license. Individual documents have their own specific licenses - please check the `license` field for each record." The datasheet says: "Metadata (licensing, thematic classification, source attribution) was extracted directly from source repository information or explicitly provided by institutional datasets."

The record's list names several licenses, which apply at once: their AND (docs/licenses.md, "Per record" and "Several licenses on one file"), so this entry holds every one of their texts.

The publisher labels each of these records with this license, and that label is the record's proof (docs/licenses.md, "The publication decides" and "Per record", maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23).

Collections whose records carry this license, as the card names and links them: The Stack (Markdown and TXT Subsets) (https://huggingface.co/datasets/bigcode/the-stack-dedup). The texts were changed by German Commons; its datasheet says: "Paragraph-level deduplication may alter texts from their original form. Personally identifiable information has been systematically removed."
licenses.text:
Records whose license field reads exactly ["https://spdx.org/licenses/CC-BY-4.0", "https://spdx.org/licenses/Apache-2.0", "https://spdx.org/licenses/MIT"] (the field is a list; WPT reads it as that JSON text).

The dataset card says of the license field: "List of applicable licenses for each document, given as canonical SPDX license URL." and "This dataset aggregation and metadata is released under ODC-BY license. Individual documents have their own specific licenses - please check the `license` field for each record." The datasheet says: "Metadata (licensing, thematic classification, source attribution) was extracted directly from source repository information or explicitly provided by institutional datasets."

The record's list names several licenses, which apply at once: their AND (docs/licenses.md, "Per record" and "Several licenses on one file"), so this entry holds every one of their texts.

The publisher labels each of these records with this license, and that label is the record's proof (docs/licenses.md, "The publication decides" and "Per record", maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23).

Collections whose records carry this license, as the card names and links them: The Stack (Markdown and TXT Subsets) (https://huggingface.co/datasets/bigcode/the-stack-dedup). Each record's source field names its collection and its id field its identifier there; both are listed in the model's CREDITS file for this source. licenses.text:
Records whose license field reads exactly ["https://spdx.org/licenses/CC-BY-4.0", "https://spdx.org/licenses/Apache-2.0", "https://spdx.org/licenses/Unlicense"] (the field is a list; WPT reads it as that JSON text).

The dataset card says of the license field: "List of applicable licenses for each document, given as canonical SPDX license URL." and "This dataset aggregation and metadata is released under ODC-BY license. Individual documents have their own specific licenses - please check the `license` field for each record." The datasheet says: "Metadata (licensing, thematic classification, source attribution) was extracted directly from source repository information or explicitly provided by institutional datasets."

The record's list names several licenses, which apply at once: their AND (docs/licenses.md, "Per record" and "Several licenses on one file"), so this entry holds every one of their texts.

The publisher labels each of these records with this license, and that label is the record's proof (docs/licenses.md, "The publication decides" and "Per record", maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23).

licenses.text:
Records whose license field reads exactly ["https://spdx.org/licenses/CC-BY-4.0", "https://spdx.org/licenses/BSD-3-Clause", "https://spdx.org/licenses/Unlicense"] (the field is a list; WPT reads it as that JSON text).

The dataset card says of the license field: "List of applicable licenses for each document, given as canonical SPDX license URL." and "This dataset aggregation and metadata is released under ODC-BY license. Individual documents have their own specific licenses - please check the `license` field for each record." The datasheet says: "Metadata (licensing, thematic classification, source attribution) was extracted directly from source repository information or explicitly provided by institutional datasets."

The record's list names several licenses, which apply at once: their AND (docs/licenses.md, "Per record" and "Several licenses on one file"), so this entry holds every one of their texts.

The publisher labels each of these records with this license, and that label is the record's proof (docs/licenses.md, "The publication decides" and "Per record", maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23).
